question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Absolute
solution:
The correct answer is: **Complete**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"absolute"** means something that is total, complete, or not diminished in any way. (पूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** The ruler had absolute power over his kingdom.
 
 
 
• **"Complete"** refers to something that is whole or finished, with all necessary parts or elements. (पूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** After two years of construction, the building is now complete.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'absolute'** is **'complete'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Complete**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bounded** (सीमित): Confined within limits.

 
 
• **Example:** The area is bounded by high walls.
 
 
 
• **Divine** (दैवीय): Of or like God or a god.
 
 
• **Example:** The priest spoke of divine intervention in their lives.
 
 
 
• **Final** (अंतिम): Coming at the end; last.
 
 
• **Example:** They reached the final stage of the competition.
